tiers.name: Basic
perks: Models at our cost, plus 40% of what we save you — nothing if we save nothing

tiers.name: Pro
tiers.blurb: A whole archive, and the breadth to actually read it.
perks: Everything in Basic, at 20% of savings instead of 40%

tiers.name: Ultra
tiers.blurb: Agents, fleets, and corpora that do not fit anywhere else.
perks: Everything in Pro, at 10% of savings — the lowest share we offer
Retrieval breadth up to top-k 256 (the engine maximum)
Concurrent agent fan-out; usage invoiced per threshold, not per seat

note: Usage is billed at our upstream cost with no markup. It is invoiced whenever accrued usage reaches $1.00, not at month end. Stripe issues that invoice shortly after the threshold is crossed, so a bill lands slightly above the threshold, never below.
